events.title: The demo version has been updated!
events.summary: We've fixed known bugs and made some changes to the game!【New Features】 ・Local multiplayer and online multiplayer are now available. ・Added an option to change the screen size. ・Improved COM opponents.【Bug Fixes】 ・Fixed several issues with COM behavior. ・Fixed several issues related to online play.We hope these changes make your voyages even more enjoyable.Have fun!

events.title: We've updated the trial version!
events.summary: We've fixed known bugs and made some changes to the game!【New Content】 ・Chapter 1 of the Campaign is now available to play. ・The Western Mediterranean fixed map can now be selected in Versus Mode.【Bug Fixes】 ・Fixed several issues with COM behavior. ・Updated and corrected text in tutorial events.You will likely experience a more comfortable voyage.Enjoy!

events.title: We've updated the Demo version!
events.summary: We’ve fixed several known bugs and made some gameplay improvements!【Bug Fixes】 ・Fixed an issue where certain text was not properly localized. ・Fixed several cases where some in-game behaviors were not working as intended.【Gameplay Changes】 ・At taverns, you can now get directions and distance information for the destinations of Royal Orders and Requests. ・At taverns, you can now hear rumors about Mystical Relics located in the surrounding area.We hope these changes make your voyages more enjoyabl

events.title: The demo version has been updated!
events.summary: We've added the ability to play against other players (up to 4 people) on the same screen, in addition to playing against the computer!Please enjoy playing with your friends.

events.title: We've released a Demo version!
events.summary: We began distributing the demo version of Forturia: Pioneer of Trade Routes today at 12:00 PM.The demo allows you to enjoy playing against the computer in versus mode.The demo lasts for 6 months (24 turns) and includes small and medium maps.We know there are still many areas for improvement, but we hope you enjoy it.
